notes: This contract directly traces the portable test to the pinned standard MIM entry. Passing installed-package runs are bounded provider evidence, not proof of provider-independent behavior or conformance.

requirements.statement: The standard MIM declares HLATSOlength as an HLAcount, updated periodically under HLAsetTiming.HLAreportPeriod, using reliable receive-order delivery, and defines it as the number of timestamp-order messages queued for delivery to the joined federate. The scenario requests the direct and periodic count while one timestamped interaction is queued, then verifies the count returns to zero after time advancement delivers the interaction.
